position.name: B2B Sales Development Representative - DACH & US (f/m/d)

jobDescription.name: What we build
jobDescription.value:
Most companies find out about supplier insolvencies, cyber attacks, factory fires or floods that affect their supply chain when it's already a crisis. Prewave exists to change that. We're an AI-native company giving BMW Group, Hilti and Lufthansa real-time visibility into supply chain risks before they become headlines.


We're looking for a Sales Development Representative (f/m/d) who takes ownership of building qualified pipeline across the DACH region and the US from day one. Someone who uses AI as a default part of how they work - and knows when to trust their own judgment.

jobDescription.name: What we are looking for
jobDescription.value:
You are the right fit if you:

  • Have 1-2 years of experience in a sales or BDR/SDR role, including first hands-on experience with cold calling
  • Speak fluent German and English, and can explain complex ideas simply and build rapport quickly in both languages, by phone or video
  • Are willing to work hours aligned with the US market, starting later in the day to reach US prospects during their business hours
  • Have a hunter mindset: resilient and competitive, and you see a "no" as a challenge, not a dead end
  • Feel comfortable speaking with senior executives and representing a sophisticated AI brand
  • Are a digital native who picks up new software quickly and is genuinely excited by how AI is changing business
  • Are based in, or willing to relocate to, Vienna
